function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas (Key Points)** | Topic | Summary | |-------|---------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are enforced; no “reasonable speed” exception.
• Speed limits on highways: 55–75 mph (often 70 mph).
• Speed limits on rural roads: 45–65 mph.
• Speed limits on city streets: 25–35 mph. | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (unless hands‑free). | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08 % or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• “Stop‑and‑yield” rules apply at uncontrolled intersections. | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• No passing on the right unless the left lane is occupied. | | **School Bus** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children. | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant.
• No parking on sidewalks or in crosswalks. | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Towing is allowed only if the vehicle is a “non‑moving” vehicle. | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Registration must be renewed annually.
• Vehicle inspections required for certain vehicles (e.g., commercial). | | **Traffic Cameras & Automated Enforcement** | • Cameras enforce speed limits, red‑light violations, and other infractions. | | **Roadway Signs** | • Texas follows the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD). | **Where to Find Official Texts** 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – Title 7, Chapter 5 (Traffic Rules). 2. **Texas Administrative Code** – Part 1, Chapter 1 (Vehicle Regulations). 3. **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV)** – Official website provides downloadable PDFs of statutes and regulations. 4. **Texas Legislature Online** – Search for “Transportation Code” or “Vehicle Code” for the most recent amendments. **Quick Reference Links** - TxDMV – Traffic Rules: https://www.txdmv.gov/traffic-rules - Texas Legislature – Transportation Code: https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TRAN/htm/TRAN.7.htm - Texas Administrative Code – Vehicle Regulations: https://texreg.com/part/1/chapter/1 Feel free to let me know if you need deeper details on a specific section or a particular regulation!
